# Vendor models

`STS3215_03a.step`: Feetech STS3215 servo, from TheRobotStudio/SO-ARM100 (`STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step`), https://github.com/TheRobotStudio/SO-ARM100, Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt` in this folder). Unmodified.

`turntable.py` places it in the assembly and shapes the servo pocket to it. One known difference from the real servo: the model has the horn centre 10.2 mm from the horn end; the servo measures 9.5 mm, and the pocket uses 9.5.
